summaries.shodan: Search internet-connected hosts, open ports, DNS and CVEs through Shodan, with a credit ledger that stops before your monthly query credits run out.

hermes-glyphwake.summary: Click the empty chat in Hermes Desktop and watch a wave of ASCII characters decode into a wordmark.

hermes-plugin-resume-session.summary: Pick up recent Claude Code, Codex and Cursor sessions inside Hermes, with a compact pick-up card and the foreign transcript kept as inert history.

Flymes.summary: An experiment: a simulated fruit fly connectome, built from real fly brain wiring, picks the agent's next tool call, with a live Desktop panel to watch it decide.
